item.title: Russia proposes carbon credits framework for SMRs
item.description: An international methodology to allow small modular reactors to qualify for carbon credits under the terms of the Paris Agreement has been proposed to the UN's climate/COP secretariat by Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.

item.title: Industry urges nuclear recognition in COP31's 35-by-35 pledge
item.description: The role that nuclear can play in achieving the COP31 summit's pledge to increase electricity to 35% of energy demand by 2035 should be acknowledged, industry leaders have said, with nuclear construction at a 40-year high.

item.title: Energy crisis reinforces comeback of nuclear power, says IEA
item.description: Unprecedented disruption in the energy world - primarily resulting from the war in the Middle East - is set to reinforce the comeback of nuclear power, according to the International Energy Agency's latest World Energy Outlook, which has revised its forecast for nuclear upwards.

item.title: Estonia narrows search for nuclear power plant location
item.description: The search for a site for Estonia's first nuclear power plant will now focus on three locations, all in the municipality of Viru-Nigula, about 120 kilometres east of Tallin, after three locations in Lüganuse municipality were ruled out for security reasons.
